data.title: RepoGlance
data.description: Read-only GitHub widgets, pinned repos, and open issues and PRs at a glance, on your Pixel home screen.

layout.eyebrow: Read-only GitHub widgets for Google Pixels
layout.heading: Your GitHub repos, at a glance, on your Pixel home screen.
layout.lead: RepoGlance puts the repositories you care about on your home screen: open issue and pull request counts, your pinned repositories by latest push, and a navigator for open issues and pull requests. It is read-only. It never changes anything on GitHub.

layout.heading: Pin what matters
layout.body: Browse the repositories you share with RepoGlance, filter them by account or organization, search, and sort by most recent push. Pin a repository right from its row. Pinned repositories sort first, and they are the only ones RepoGlance refreshes in the background, about every 30 minutes on a network connection.

layout.heading: Open issues and pull requests
layout.body: Open a repository to see its open issues and pull requests, or just one kind, and search the loaded rows. A tap opens the full thread in the GitHub app.

layout.heading: Widgets and a Quick Settings tile
layout.body: A Repository widget shows open issue and pull request counts, with the latest items at the taller size. A Pinned repos widget lists your pinned repositories, most recent push first. A Quick Settings tile shows your latest push. Every value shows how old it is: when GitHub can't be reached you see the last good value with its age, or no data, never a made-up zero.

layout.heading: Try it without an account
layout.body: Tap Explore with sample data on the first screen to try the catalog, the repository views, the widgets and the Quick Settings tile on made-up repositories, clearly marked SAMPLE. Sample mode makes no network requests.

layout.heading: Read-only. No server. No tracking.
layout.intro: RepoGlance is built to tell the truth about your repositories, and to stay out of the way.

items.text: RepoGlance never comments, closes, labels, assigns, merges or re-runs anything on GitHub.
There is no RepoGlance server. The app talks only to GitHub, directly from your phone.
Sign-in is GitHub's own device flow: you enter a short code on GitHub's page, so RepoGlance never sees your password. Your token is encrypted with Android Keystore and used only to reach GitHub.
No ads, no analytics, no trackers. Disconnect GitHub in Settings to delete your session and cached data from the phone.
Unknown is never shown as zero. Stale data is labelled with its age. A rate limit is shown, never hidden behind old numbers.
Not yet: a CI column. This build does not fetch CI state.

layout.heading: Help test RepoGlance
layout.body: RepoGlance 0.4.0-beta.1 is in closed testing on Google Play. It is made for Pixel phones and foldables, with Material You dynamic color and light and dark themes. Join the testers group to get the build.

data.title: Join the closed test
data.description: How to join the RepoGlance closed test on Google Play: join the testers group, accept the test, install the app.

layout.heading: Join the RepoGlance closed test.
layout.lead: RepoGlance 0.4.0-beta.1 is a closed test on Google Play. It runs on Android 12 or newer and is made for Pixel phones and foldables. Joining takes a Google account and a few minutes.

layout.heading: Three steps
layout.intro: Google Play checks membership in the testers group, so the group comes first.

steps.text: Join the RepoGlance testers Google Group with the Google account you use on Google Play. Anyone on the web can join.
Accept the test on Google Play. The opt-in link is not published yet; it will appear here as soon as Google Play shows it.
Install RepoGlance from Google Play. On the first screen, sign in with GitHub, or tap Explore with sample data to try everything on made-up repositories.

layout.note: Joining the group installs nothing. Leave the group at any time to leave the test.

items.text: Sign in with GitHub's device flow and pin the repositories you share with RepoGlance.
Open a repository's issues and pull requests; a tap opens the thread in the GitHub app.
Add Repository and Pinned repos widgets from Widgets in the app's menu or from your home screen's widget picker, plus a Quick Settings tile.
Explore with sample data to try all of it without an account.

layout.heading: Feedback
layout.body: Report problems and ideas as GitHub issues. Say which phone and Android version you are on, and whether you were in sample mode or signed in.

layout.heading: Privacy
layout.body: RepoGlance has no server and collects nothing. The privacy policy explains what stays on your phone and how to remove it.
